build_mobileone_block_train: build a MobileOneBlock with over-parameterized branches for training with specified in and out channels
build_mobileone_block_deploy: build a MobileOneBlock in deploy mode with re-parameterized single path for inference
run_mobileone_forward_train: run the forward pass of a MobileOneBlock in training mode with multi-branch skip connections
run_mobileone_forward_deploy: run the forward pass of a MobileOneBlock in deploy mode with a single depthwise then pointwise path
review_mobileone_over_param_branches: review the MobileOneBlock over-parameterization branches configuration to adjust the number of parallel dw and pw branches
